newsitem.title: USA: K-III creates office of the chairman.
newsitem.headline: K-III creates office of the chairman.

text.p: K-III Communications said Thursday it elected Harry McQuillen chief operating officer and created an office of the chairman to guide the operational and financial strategies of the company.

The company said the office will include K-III chairman and chief executive William Reilly, president Charles McCurdy, vice chairman and general counsel Beverly Chell, McQuillen and executive vice president Jack Farnsworth.
The company said McQuillen was promoted from his job as executive vice president. The chief operating officer is a new position in the company.
